<style id="dc-v9-css-3">
.beta-n{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mu);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:20px;font-style:italic}
.bfull{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);background:var(--purple);border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:13px;border-radius:7px;display:block;text-align:center;text-decoration:none;transition:background .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.bfull:hover{background:var(--purple-hover);box-shadow:0 6px 22px rgba(108,114,255,.28)}
.rgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px;margin-bottom:56px}
.rc{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bo);border-radius:10px;padding:26px;transition:border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.rc:hover{border-color:var(--bp);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(108,114,255,.07)}
.rcn{font-size:28px;font-weight:800;color:rgba(108,114,255,.16);letter-spacing:-.05em;line-height:1;margin-bottom:9px}
.rct{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:6px}
.rcb{font-size:14px;color:var(--se);line-height:1.65}
.brow{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.bout{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);background:transparent;border:1.5px solid var(--bp);cursor:pointer;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:7px;text-decoration:none;transition:border-color .2s,background .2s}
.bout:hover{border-color:var(--purple);background:var(--pd)}
.ptrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.ptags{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px}
.ptag{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--se);background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bo);border-radius:100px;padding:5px 14px}
.pcards{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.pcard{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bo);border-radius:10px;padding:20px 22px;display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;transition:border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.pcard:hover{border-color:var(--bp);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(108,114,255,.07)}
.pi{flex-shrink:0;margin-top:1px;display:flex}
.pt{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:4px}
.pd{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--se);line-height:1.6}
.dr-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bp);border-radius:12px;padding:36px;margin-top:36px}
.dr-wrap--inline{margin-top:0;padding:22px 20px;gap:20px;background:var(--bg3);height:100%;align-content:center}
.dr-wrap--inline .dr-ring{width:112px;height:112px}
.dr-wrap--inline .dr-val{font-size:24px}
.dr-wrap--inline .dr-metrics{gap:10px}
.dr-wrap--inline .drm{padding:11px 12px}
.dr-ring{position:relative;width:140px;height:140px;flex-shrink:0}
.dr-ring svg{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.dr-bg{fill:none;stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.07);stroke-width:8}
.dr-fill{fill:none;stroke:url(#rg);stroke-width:8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:380;stroke-dashoffset:380;transition:stroke-dashoffset 2.4s var(--ease)}
.dr-center{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);text-align:center}
.dr-val{font-size:28px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--white);line-height:1}
.dr-sub{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mu)}
.dr-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.drm{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--bo);border-radius:8px;padding:14px}
.drm-l{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:7px}
.drm-track{height:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:100px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:6px}
.drm-bar{height:100%;width:0%;border-radius:100px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--purple),var(--pl));transition:width 2s var(--ease)}
.drm-v{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white)}
#why{border-top:1px solid var(--bo)}
.wgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:56px;align-items:start;margin-top:8px}
.founder-block{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:flex-start}
.founder-av{width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 18%;border:1px solid var(--bp);box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.wq{max-width:34em;margin-bottom:12px}
.wq p{font-family:var(--font);font-size:clamp(15px,1.75vw,18px);font-weight:400;color:rgba(250,243,225,.82);line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 14px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.wq p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.wa{font-size:14px;color:var(--mu);font-weight:500;margin-top:4px}
.wcards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}
.wc{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bo);border-radius:10px;padding:20px;transition:border-color .3s}
.wc:hover{border-color:var(--bp)}
.wcl{font-size:13px;color:var(--se);line-height:1.6}
.wcl strong{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);margin-bottom:5px}
#faq{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--bo);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bo)}
.faq-list{border:1px solid var(--bo);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:48px}
.faq-q{width:100%;background:var(--bg2);border:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bo);padding:20px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s;text-align:left}
.faq-item:last-child .faq-q{border-bottom:none}
.faq-item.open .faq-q{background:var(--bg3)}
.faq-q-t{font-size:15.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.faq-ico{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--bp);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;transition:transform .3s,background .3s}
.faq-ico svg{width:10px;height:10px;stroke:var(--pl);stroke-width:2;fill:none;transition:transform .3s}
.faq-item.open .faq-ico{background:var(--pd)}
.faq-item.open .faq-ico svg{transform:rotate(45deg)}
.faq-a{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .45s var(--ease)}
.faq-ai{padding:0 24px 20px;font-size:15px;color:var(--se);line-height:1.75}
#cta{text-align:center;padding:112px 48px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.cta-in{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:580px;margin:0 auto}
.ctah{font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,48px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:14px}
.ctasub{font-size:16.5px;color:var(--se);line-height:1.65;margin-bottom:36px}
.ctapair{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
.ctafine{font-size:12px;color:var(--mu)}
footer{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--bo);padding:56px 48px 32px}
.ft{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto}
.ftop{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:44px;padding-bottom:44px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bo);margin-bottom:28px}
.ftop>div:first-child{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
.fbrand{margin:0 0 12px;line-height:0;display:block;overflow:visible}
.fbrand img{height:clamp(40px,4.2vw,48px);width:auto;display:block;margin:0}
.ftag{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mu);line-height:1.8;margin:0;align-self:flex-start}
.fcolh{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:14px}
.flinks{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.flinks a{font-size:14px;color:var(--se);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s}
.flinks a:hover{color:var(--white)}
.flink-disabled{font-size:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.24);cursor:default;pointer-events:none;user-select:none}
.flegal .flink-disabled{font-size:12.5px}
.fbot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.fcopy{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mu)}
.flegal{display:flex;gap:18px}
.flegal a{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mu);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s}
.flegal a:hover{color:var(--se)}
.fu{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .65s var(--ease),transform .65s var(--ease)}
.fu.vis{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media(max-width:960px){nav{padding:0 20px}.nl{display:none}.nmenu{display:flex}.nr .nbg,.nr .nbn{display:none}#hero{padding:120px 20px 80px;min-height:auto}.hero-grid{gap:32px;justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%}.hleft{align-items:center;text-align:center;padding:0 4px}.h1wrap{--hr-lh:clamp(28px,7vw,44px);--hr-slots:3;--hr-center:1;flex-direction:column;overflow:visible;width:100%;max-width:100%;justify-content:center;align-items:center;margin:0 auto;gap:.12em}.hstatic,.hrword{font-size:clamp(22px,6.2vw,34px)}.hrwrap{max-width:100%;margin:0 auto}.hrword{justify-content:center;text-align:center}.hsub{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}.hctas{justify-content:center}.htrust{margin:0 auto}#proofbar{padding:14px 20px}section,#cta,#how,#faq{padding:68px 20px}.rgrid,.og,.ptrow,.wgrid,.wcards,.dr-wrap,.ftop{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.dr-wrap--inline .dr-ring{margin:0 auto 8px}.pgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.fbtabs-scroll{scroll-snap-type:x mandatory}.fbt{min-width:88px;scroll-snap-align:center;flex:0 0 auto}.fbtabs::before{display:none}.fbprogress{margin:6px 16px 0}.audtabs{grid-template-columns:1fr}.audt{border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bo)}.audt:last-child{border-bottom:none}.fbp2{grid-template-columns:1fr}.founder-block{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center}}
@media(max-width:640px){.ftop{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
html.dl-embed-shell #nav{display:none!important}
html.dl-embed-shell footer{padding:56px clamp(24px,4vw,48px) 32px}
html.dl-embed-shell #hero{padding:88px clamp(24px,4vw,80px) 80px!important;min-height:0!important;align-items:flex-start!important;justify-content:flex-start!important}
html.dl-embed-shell .hbadge{margin-top:26px}
@media(min-width:961px){html.dl-embed-shell .hbadge{margin-top:56px}}
html.dl-embed-shell [id]{scroll-margin-top:0}
html.dl-embed-shell #audiences,html.dl-embed-shell #how,html.dl-embed-shell #faq,html.dl-embed-shell #problem,html.dl-embed-shell #why,html.dl-embed-shell #cta{padding:64px clamp(24px,4vw,48px)!important}

</style>
